mentions.name: Semiotique
mentions.description: Semiotique is an early-stage Python library intended to grow into a framework, SDK, and programming language for seamlessly meshing plain code with LLM evaluations. Its runtime performs smart context engineering in the background to steer the LLM and improve correctness, with the goal of enabling agentic applications that leverage LLM flexibility while retaining the determinism of regular code.
mentions.problem: Building agentic applications that combine the flexibility of LLMs with the determinism of regular code
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on Semiotique (still very early stage).

Right now it's a python library, but the vision is to build a new framework / SDK / programming language which allows you to seamlessly mesh "plain old code" with LLM evaluations, while having a runtime which does "smart" context engineering in the background in order to steer the LLM and improve its correctness.

The end-goal is for this paradigm to enable new kinds of agentic applications, which leverage the flexibility of LLMs while retaining the determinism of regular code.
